name: @treaty/deploy
description: Build-to-deploy for Treaty apps. Treaty compiles every lazy feature route and library into an independently versioned, deployable, rollback-able federated module (see @treaty/module-federation); @treaty/federation-deploy is the versioned-manifest + pluggable-deploy layer. This package is the assembly step between a finished build and a release: assembleDeployArtifact({ buildDir, manifest, target }) walks a built output directory against a FederationManifest and produces a DeployArtifact — the exact files to upload, the manifest to publish, and the per-module versioned upload paths needed for partial deploy and rollback. deploy(artifact, target) hands that artifact to a pluggable DeployTarget (Treaty is a compiler, not a host: it emits the artifact and invokes a target, it never runs a server). A reference FsDeployTarget writes the artifact to a local directory and maintains the on-disk manifest; a structural CloudDeployTarget interface models self-hosted object-storage / static-host / Treaty-cloud backends, and any @treaty/federation-deploy DeployPlugin is adaptable into a target. Partial deploy (only the modules a change touches, via computeAffectedModules) and rollback (flip one manifest entry to an already-published version) are first-class.
author: Jordan Hall
